messages:
Arman PM: Heads-up: Mercury Retail wants a GA commitment for Dedicated in EU with a 99.99% SLA, regional residency, and guaranteed Black Friday burst capacity. They want billing credits and a simple activation calendar. Can we scope this for GA?
Priya Eng: short answer: maybe, but not without gating. We need deterministic reservation, prefix KV warming, and runbook-tested autoscale. Also region-specific capacity tests for EU nodes.
Jules SRE: ops concerns: Black Friday is a giant tail event. require a 30d burn-in in EU, 72h soak, chaos injection, and a documented rollback. can't promise 99.99 before that.
Nora Sales: Mercury pushes for a contract clause: SLA active from contract signing + 7d. They'd like credits to be automatic on breach. They're willing to accept a credit cap (3 months) if we provide a pilot activation window.
Talia Legal: we need measurement windows (rolling 30d), carve-outs (scheduled maintenance, force majeure, customer misuse), and a credit formula. Also want the authority to flip SLA toggle defined.
Ben Docs: doc gaps: no customer-facing Dedicated SLA with regional residency text, no examples of credit calculations, no runbook template. I can draft both but need the exact formula and the activation policy.
Arman PM: proposal: staged activation with explicit milestones. Offer Mercury a phased path: Pilot (99.90), Ramp (99.95), Full (99.99). Full unlock requires: perf baseline, 30d EU burn-in, docs+legal, and deterministic burst verification (pre-reserved slots test).
Priya Eng: implementation sketch:
```
mercury_config:
  sla_tier: "full"      # pilot|ramp|full
  region: "eu-west-1"
  burst_reservation: 200
  prewarm_prefixes: ["/mercury/checkout", "/mercury/search"]
  measurement_window: "rolling_30d"
  credit_policy: "automatic"
```
Priya Eng: need a control-plane toggle per-customer + emergency kill switch. ETA: toggle + tagging 1 sprint, deterministic reservation + prewarm 2 more sprints.
Jules SRE: monitoring checklist to ship to Console: mercury.eu: latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate, slot_utilization, prewarm_hit_rate. Alerts: p99 > 300ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> page oncall.
Nora Sales: for contract simplicity, propose credit formula: credit = min( (downtime_seconds / window_seconds) * monthly_fee, credit_cap ) where credit_cap = 3 * monthly_fee. Want it automated.
Talia Legal: tweak: measurement_window_seconds = 30 * 24 * 3600. define downtime_seconds = seconds outside SLO in that window after excluding carve-outs. We'll draft clause.
Ben Docs: I'll add a worked example: if monthly_fee = $100k, downtime=3600s over 30d -> credit = min( (3600/(30*86400))*100k, 3*100k ) = ~$1,157. I'll include that in draft.
Arman PM: GA acceptance checklist for Mercury Full SLA:
- Perf baseline validated (eng load tests)
- 72h soak + 30d EU burn-in with no Sev1s
- Runbook + oncall playbook published in Docs
- Control-plane toggle + emergency kill switch implemented
- Credit formula & legal SLA appendix signed
- Deterministic burst test passed (simulate Black Friday peak)
If any missing -> offer Ramp (99.95) with scheduled upgrade path.
Jules SRE: will schedule the EU capacity harness and chaos runs next week. tagging results to Console and ticket.
Priya Eng: will start work on toggle + tagging today and open two PRs: control-plane toggle; reservation allocator.
Nora Sales: I'll propose the staged calendar to Mercury: Pilot -> 30d Ramp -> Full after burn-in. They may accept a conditional early activation if we hold back credits until burn-in completes.
Talia Legal: will prepare SLA appendix + carve-out language; need product to confirm who can approve stage flip (suggest product + infra lead).
infra-bot: Ticket PROD-27111 created: "Mercury Retail: Dedicated EU SLA onramp, toggle, capacity harness, docs"  assignees: @Priya Eng, @Jules SRE.
Ben Docs: ETA for first drafts: SLA page + runbook stub in 4 business days; will PR once legal text is ready.
Arman PM: decision: we won't promise 99.99 at GA unless a pilot completes Full. For GA we can commit to Ramp (99.95) with explicit upgrade milestones. We'll offer a commercial concession: temporary reserved burst slots during Ramp.
Nora Sales: noted. I'll loop Mercury and include credit cap language.
Priya Eng: opening PRs and will tag this thread.
Jules SRE: first harness run scheduled Wed; will attach logs to PROD-27111.
Arman PM: thanks team. check-in Friday morning. Ping me if blockers. :spiral_calendar:
